I have some schooling, so I look at the cost and the size of this plot, and for 0.78 hectares I will not buy too many inputs, only what I think I can manage well. Since this plot is my own, I will also put manure where I have it, keep hybrid seed, and use family labor first, then hire a few days only when work is heavy.
